root_cause: Bad release introduced null pointer in payment handler
resolution: Rolled back deployment to previous version
preventive_action: Added canary stage and contract tests for payment handler

root_cause: OOMKilled pods after cache size increase
resolution: Increased memory limit and reduced cache size
preventive_action: Added memory usage alert at 85 percent of limit

root_cause: RDS connection exhaustion after scale-out of order-service
resolution: Reduced connection pool size and introduced RDS Proxy
preventive_action: Pool size formula added to service template

root_cause: ImagePullBackOff because CI pipeline failed to push image
preventive_action: Pipeline now blocks deploy if image push fails

root_cause: ALB 502 errors because app keep-alive timeout shorter than ALB idle timeout
resolution: Increased app keep-alive timeout to 75 seconds
preventive_action: Added keep-alive setting to service checklist

root_cause: Pods pending because node group reached max size
resolution: Increased node group maximum and added autoscaler alert
preventive_action: Capacity review added to monthly SRE meeting

root_cause: Expired TLS certificate on internal service
resolution: Renewed certificate in ACM and restarted pods
preventive_action: Added certificate expiry alert at 30 days

root_cause: Long running query locked tables during business hours
resolution: Killed the query and moved report to read replica
preventive_action: Reports restricted to read replica and query timeout set

root_cause: Redis cache failover caused cascading timeouts
resolution: Failed over manually and restarted affected pods
preventive_action: Added circuit breaker and retry backoff to checkout client

root_cause: CPU saturation on EC2 nodes during traffic spike
preventive_action: Lowered target tracking threshold from 70 to 55 percent

root_cause: CrashLoopBackOff due to missing ConfigMap key after release
resolution: Added missing key and restarted deployment
preventive_action: Helm chart validation added to CI

root_cause: Security group change blocked ALB to pod traffic
resolution: Reverted security group rule via Terraform
preventive_action: Security group changes now require two reviewers
